bibl.title: How (not) to organise Roman textile production. Some considerations on merchant-entrepreneurs in Roman Egypt and the ἱστωνάρχης.
bibl.seg: Kerstin Dross-Krüpe, How (not) to organise Roman textile production. Some considerations on merchant-entrepreneurs in Roman Egypt and the ἱστωνάρχης.
Maria Mossakowska-Gaubert (ed.), Egyptian textiles and their production: 'word' and 'object' (Hellenistic, Roman and Byzantine periods) = Zea E-Books. 86 (Lincoln, Nebraska, 2020) pp. 128-138, fig.
bibl.note: Preliminary remarks. - Putting-out system and merchant-entrepreneurs: On the genesis of an idea; - Specialisation and qualification; - External acquisition of the necessary raw materials and external marketing / distribution of the manufactured products; - High degree of standardisation; - Economic dependence and remuneration; - Merchant-entrepreneurs outside of Egypt. - Excursus: the archive of Apollonius and the ἱστωνάρχης Chairemon. - Conclusion.
